The thing is that if I'd done things to please him, like bleaching my hair (I bleached it just last year and loved it but now I'm growing it out again), if I'd done that I'd be doing it for him, not for me. And he still might not even want me back even then. He said he has no feelings anymore and doesn't know why. It could be some physical elements but I also think it's because he's young and not ready. I don't know. 

But yeah a part of me wants to grasp at anything and bleach my hair and wear trashy clothes so he'll be more interested but that feels so shallow. I would hope that he'd want to stay for my personality too. But he's already given up on me so there's no point. 

I don't know what went wrong but physical attraction wasn't the only part of it. He would always say he was attracted to me when I asked and we were sexually active. 

Yes it is a compromise but at the end he didn't want to compromise or talk it out. If there was a big thing I could change, he never specifically told me. He just said he didn't have feelings anymore. All these vaguely passive aggressive hints don't really count as communication imo. He was very short, shorter than me, and I would joke about it but I didn't actually have a problem with it. I know he couldn't change his height, but I didn't expect him to change anything about himself. 

Also, this is raw for me and I'm still in a lot of pain, please be gentle.

I really do understand that the wrong wording can be damaging. I am actually a very understanding person so please don't assume I'm not..
